subject: Can I use Lavaan for SEM of multilevel survey data?

messages.author: 0556d20de13071dc
messages.subject: Can I use Lavaan for SEM of multilevel survey data?
parts:
Hi, 

Would you confirm if Lavaan can handle multilevel, binary outcome/input, complex survey data (with varying sampling weight) for SEM? 
Thank you very much.

Best,

Tiffany

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Can I use Lavaan for SEM of multilevel survey data?
parts:
On 08/27/2014 06:05 PM, Tiffany Jung wrote:
> Hi,
>
> Would you confirm if Lavaan can handle multilevel, binary outcome/input,
> complex survey data (with varying sampling weight) for SEM?

No.

If the data is continuous, we can deal with complex survey data using
the lavaan.survey package. But this will NOT work for categorical data.

Yves.
